diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_import: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}} because {{src}} changes with this import. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_import_via: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}}: {{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} changes with this import. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.

diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}}, which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_foreign: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{src}} does not come from the import), which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.

diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_changed: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} because {{src}} has changed, so it no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_changed_via: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} has changed), which no longer matches the DB bytes. diag.KOP_NO_OUTPUT: Network {{network}}: The network has no output (coil or box): it has no effect.
diag.KOP_EMPTY_BRANCH: Network {{network}}: Branch {{branch}} is empty: add an element or delete it.
diag.KOP_MIDLINE_ON_RAIL: Network {{network}}: The midline output (#) needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.KOP_RET_ON_RAIL: Network {{network}}: RET is connected directly to the rail: add a condition before it.
diag.KOP_EDGE_ON_RAIL: Network {{network}}: The edge needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.KOP_NOT_ON_RAIL: Network {{network}}: NOT needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.KOP_BOX_IN_PIN: Network {{network}}: A box cannot sit in the logic of a pin: compute it in an earlier network with a coil on a memory bit, and use a contact of that bit in the pin.
diag.KOP_BOX_IN_PARALLEL: Network {{network}}: A box cannot sit inside a parallel branch: put it in series on the main line (or at the start of a T branch) with a coil on a memory bit after it, and use a contact of that bit in the branch.
diag.KOP_BOX_IN_TBRANCH: Network {{network}}: A box in a T branch can only be its first element: move the logic before it into the series ahead of the branch, or put it in its own network and carry the result with a memory bit.
diag.KOP_BAD_LABEL: Network {{network}}: Invalid label "{{label}}": 1 to 4 characters, the first one a letter.
diag.KOP_BAD_INSTANCE: Network {{network}}: The box instance is not valid.
diag.KOP_MUST_BE_ALONE: Network {{network}}: This output must be the only one at its point: it cannot have other outputs in parallel.
diag.KOP_TOO_MANY_LABELS: Network {{network}}: Too many jump labels in the network.
diag.KOP_LINE_BREAK: Network {{network}}: An operand contains a line break: write it on one line.
diag.JL_TARGET: The JL label must follow the jump list.
diag.JUMP_ALIGN: The jump target is not aligned.
diag.JUMP_TOO_FAR: The jump is too far ({{words}} words).
diag.LAYOUT_SFB_SCONOSCIUTO: The real instance layout of {{sfb}} is unknown, or the imported blocks give different ones (internal static data, genre of the instance DB): the catalog only has the documented parameters. It must come from a real block, for example a kit read from the PLC.

diag.RAW_IN_CHANGED_NETWORK: Network modified: it contains raw MC7 instructions. Restore the network or remove the raw lines.
diag.RAW_JUMP_ACROSS_CHANGED: A raw MC7 jump crosses a modified network (or the number of networks changed). Restore the networks or remove the raw jumps.
diag.RAW_META_MISMATCH: The raw instructions in the text do not match the metadata: the bytes of the lines are used.
diag.RAW_REMOVED: Network modified: {{count}} raw MC7 instructions are gone and their bytes are not in the code.

diag.VALORI_ATTUALI_PERSI: The recompiled DB uses the initial values (and, in an instance DB, the instance values): the actual values of the original that cannot be written there are not kept (in a global DB all of them; in an instance DB arrays, pointers, parameters and values whose literal does not give back the same bytes).
diag.VALORI_INIZIALI_DA_CAMPIONE: Initial values of the SFB internal static data taken from the real block {{sample}}.

diag.NO_OUTPUT: The network has no output (coil or box): it has no effect.
diag.EMPTY_BRANCH: Branch {{branch}} is empty: add an element or delete it.
diag.MIDLINE_ON_RAIL: The midline output (#) needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.RET_ON_RAIL: RET is connected directly to the rail: add a condition before it.
diag.EDGE_ON_RAIL: The edge needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.NOT_ON_RAIL: NOT needs logic on its left: it cannot start from the rail.
diag.BOX_IN_PARALLEL: A box cannot sit inside a parallel branch: put it in series on the main line (or at the start of a T branch) with a coil on a memory bit after it, and use a contact of that bit in the branch.
diag.BOX_IN_TBRANCH: A box in a T branch can only be its first element: move the logic before it into the series ahead of the branch, or put it in its own network and carry the result with a memory bit.
diag.BOX_IN_PIN: A box cannot sit in the logic of a pin: compute it in an earlier network with a coil on a memory bit, and use a contact of that bit in the pin.
diag.BAD_LABEL: Invalid label "{{label}}": 1 to 4 characters, the first one a letter.
diag.BAD_INSTANCE: The box instance is not valid.
diag.MUST_BE_ALONE: This output must be the only one at its point: it cannot have other outputs in parallel.
diag.TOO_MANY_LABELS: Too many jump labels in the network.
diag.LINE_BREAK: An operand contains a line break: write it on one line.
